title: Coordinatewise monotonicity
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube, and choose a coordinate $i$. The function is monotone in coordinate $i$ if, for every input $x$, its value when coordinate $i$ is set to $-1$ is at most its value when coordinate $i$ is set to $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube
